decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's established crew recruitment and maritime expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate early results and apply related knowledge to improve the service.
The growing partner network of the maritime education programme shows early success and aligns with the firm's established training capabilities, allowing effective learning and improvement.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the firm's existing technical and compliance offer, and the successful deadline transfer of monitoring plans demonstrates strong related knowledge.

The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's established PAL ship management software and builds directly on existing digital capabilities, making it easier to interpret feedback and improve.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool leverages the firm's existing PAL software and emissions expertise, providing the related knowledge needed to assimilate user data and refine the tool.
